gaps.term: Inversion of the transform via the opposite transform
gaps.note: The page asserts the inversion F_q^+ F_q f = f/q but gives neither the formula for the opposite transform nor its normalization, nor any argument such as orthogonality of roots of unity, so the reader cannot check it from the page.

gaps.term: Normalization factor in the convolution identity
gaps.quote: Each sum on the right is $q$ times a frequency entry
gaps.note: This step needs the 1/q normalization of the transform, which the page never states. The reader can only guess it from the word normalized in the known concept name, so the factor q cannot be checked from the page.
